reply.answer_text: I'm not able to process trustee changes, but I can explain the route. An LPA gives you no power to act as trustee — that role is personal. Your mum would need to be replaced as trustee by deed under the Trustee Act 1925, section 36. This needs agreement of the other trustees (if any) and possibly Court of Protection consent if she has a beneficial interest in the trust. You'll need to speak to our senior case handler who manages trustee changes. They'll guide you on the deed and verification needed.
